How to use

Drawing

  • Pick a road type at the top, then draw with the pen.
  • Start or end near a town or another road and the line snaps to it. A blue ring shows where.
  • Zoom in before drawing for finer bends.
  • Rail lines snap to towns and to other rail lines, not to roads.

Moving around

  • One finger moves the map. Pinch to zoom. Fit shows all of Euelia.
  • No pen? Turn on Draw with a finger in the View menu; two fingers still move and zoom.

Fixing things

  • Tap with two fingers to undo.
  • Press and hold on a road to select it, with any tool. Then tap a type to change it, or Delete.
  • Erase: rub over the part of a road to remove. A pen's eraser end also works.

Saving

  • A red dot on Save means there are changes not yet saved to a file.
  • Save writes a .geojson file. If the browser cannot write to a folder directly, the file goes to Downloads; move it into Story\maps.
  • The page also keeps a backup in this browser after every change.

With a keyboard or mouse

  • 1–5 road type, D S E M tools, Ctrl+Z undo, Ctrl+Y redo, Ctrl+S save, Delete.
  • Mouse wheel zooms; hold Space or right-drag to move.

Towns are locked and cannot be moved here.
